subjectPreparation: Measure over close-fitting base clothing or underwear; remove shoes, belts, bulky layers, and pocket contents.
Subject stands naturally with weight balanced unless a field states another posture.
Mark the waist, acromion points, neck base, right radial-styloid point, crotch point, and other named landmarks before the first observation.
Do not infer a missing value from garment size, another person, a photograph, BMI, or an automated scale conversion.
tools: non-stretch flexible body-measurement tape with millimetre graduations
stadiometer or rigid vertical rule for height
washable skin marker or removable landmark stickers
optional elastic waist cord kept level

unitPolicy.rounding: round accepted result to the nearest whole millimetre

observationPolicy.independenceRule: Release and reposition the tape or tool and re-identify the path before the second observation.
observationPolicy.acceptanceRule: Accept when the absolute difference between the two observations is no greater than the field repeatToleranceMm.
observationPolicy.retryRule: If the first two observations disagree, take one third independent observation. Accept only the closest pair when its difference is within repeatToleranceMm; otherwise stop and review landmarks, posture, tool tension, and operator training.
observationPolicy.resultRule: Store the rounded arithmetic mean of the accepted pair.
observationPolicy.noPairRule: Do not store a value when no pair passes tolerance. Preserve the field as missing and record a review reason outside the measurement value.

globalProcedure.tapeTension: Tape lies in contact with the body without compressing soft tissue and without slack.
globalProcedure.breathing: For torso circumferences, record at the end of a normal relaxed exhalation; do not ask the subject to inhale, hold the abdomen, or pose.
globalProcedure.privacy: The protocol defines measurements only. Names, photographs, comments, consent records, and raw repeated observations remain outside this registry.
globalProcedure.mutationPolicy: Existing records are never silently rewritten; corrections require operator confirmation and an audit trail.

fields.definitionEn: Horizontal torso circumference through the fullest chest or bust level, under the arms.
fields.definitionRu: Горизонтальный обхват туловища через наиболее выступающую точку груди, под руками.
fields.posture: Standing naturally, arms relaxed slightly away from the torso for tape placement and then lowered.
fields.tapePath: Pass the tape horizontally around the torso at the marked fullest level; confirm level at front, sides, and back; read at normal exhalation.

fields.definitionEn: Horizontal torso circumference immediately below breast tissue at the inframammary level.
fields.definitionRu: Горизонтальный обхват туловища непосредственно под грудью на уровне подгрудной складки.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with arms relaxed after tape placement.
fields.tapePath: Pass the tape horizontally around the ribcage immediately below breast tissue and read at normal exhalation.

fields.definitionEn: Horizontal circumference at the natural waist marked by the side-bend crease, not a preferred garment waistband.
fields.definitionRu: Горизонтальный обхват естественной талии, отмеченной по складке при боковом наклоне, а не по желаемой линии пояса одежды.
fields.posture: Return to relaxed upright standing after locating the waist; abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Place a level elastic cord on the marked natural waist, then measure around the same plane at normal exhalation.
commonMistakes: tape above or below the marked plane

fields.definitionEn: Horizontal torso circumference on a plane 100 mm below the marked natural waist.
fields.definitionRu: Горизонтальный обхват туловища в плоскости на 100 мм ниже отмеченной естественной талии.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with feet together and abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Mark points 100 mm vertically below the waist at front, sides, and back; pass the tape level through those points.
commonMistakes: measuring 100 mm along the body instead of vertically

fields.definitionEn: Maximum horizontal circumference around the seat and hips through the fullest buttock projection.
fields.definitionRu: Максимальный горизонтальный обхват таза через наиболее выступающие точки ягодиц.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with feet together and weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Move the level tape vertically until the maximum seat circumference is found; keep it horizontal and read without compression.
commonMistakes: tape caught above the fullest buttock level

fields.definitionEn: Circumference of the neck base through the seventh cervical prominence, neck-shoulder junctions, and suprasternal notch.
fields.definitionRu: Обхват основания шеи через выступ седьмого шейного позвонка, точки перехода шеи в плечи и яремную вырезку.
fields.posture: Head in a natural forward position, shoulders relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Follow the sloped base-of-neck contour through all four landmarks; do not measure a horizontal collar line.

fields.definitionEn: Straight horizontal breadth between the left and right acromion points; it is not a tape contour over the neck.
fields.definitionRu: Прямая горизонтальная ширина между левым и правым акромионами; это не дуга сантиметровой ленты через шею.
fields.posture: Standing naturally, shoulders relaxed and level, arms hanging.
fields.tapePath: Use a rigid breadth tool when available, or hold the tape straight without following the back contour, between the two marked acromion points.

fields.definitionEn: Straight endpoint span from the right acromion to the right radial styloid with the elbow extended and wrist neutral; it is not a bent-elbow surface or garment sleeve length.
fields.definitionRu: Прямое расстояние между правым акромионом и шиловидным отростком правой лучевой кости при выпрямленном локте и нейтральном запястье; это не длина по согнутой руке и не длина рукава одежды.
landmarks: right radial styloid at thumb side of wrist
fields.posture: Standing naturally with the right arm extended downward, elbow straight without hyperextension, wrist neutral, and fingers relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Measure the straight endpoint-to-endpoint span from the marked right acromion to the marked right radial styloid with a rigid length tool or a tape held straight; do not follow the arm surface or elbow contour.
commonMistakes: following the arm surface over the elbow
ending at the ulnar styloid, wrist crease, or knuckles

fields.definitionEn: Maximum circumference of the relaxed upper arm between shoulder and elbow.
fields.definitionRu: Максимальный обхват расслабленного плеча между плечевым суставом и локтем.
fields.posture: Arm hanging relaxed, palm facing the thigh; do not flex the muscle.
fields.tapePath: Search along the upper arm for the maximum level and measure perpendicular to the arm axis.

fields.definitionEn: Circumference at the wrist crease over the distal radius and ulna prominences.
fields.definitionRu: Обхват по линии запястья через выступы лучевой и локтевой костей.
fields.posture: Forearm relaxed, hand open, wrist neutral.
fields.tapePath: Pass the tape around the marked wrist level without adding cuff ease.

fields.definitionEn: Vertical distance from the crotch point to the floor along the inside leg, barefoot.
fields.definitionRu: Вертикальное расстояние от точки промежности до пола вдоль внутренней стороны ноги, без обуви.
fields.posture: Standing barefoot, feet approximately 100 mm apart, legs straight, weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Seat a thin rigid card or measuring aid horizontally at the crotch point and measure vertically to the floor beside the inside leg.
commonMistakes: aid not seated at crotch point

fields.definitionEn: Maximum circumference of the upper thigh immediately below the gluteal fold.
fields.definitionRu: Максимальный обхват верхней части бедра непосредственно под ягодичной складкой.
fields.posture: Standing with weight balanced and muscles relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Place the tape perpendicular to the thigh axis just below the gluteal fold and confirm the maximum nearby circumference.

fields.definitionEn: Circumference through the midpoint of the patella with the knee straight and relaxed.
fields.definitionRu: Обхват через середину надколенника при выпрямленном и расслабленном колене.
fields.posture: Standing, knee extended without locking, weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Pass the tape perpendicular to the leg axis through the patella midpoint.

fields.definitionEn: Maximum circumference of the relaxed calf.
fields.definitionRu: Максимальный обхват расслабленной икры.
fields.posture: Standing with weight balanced and calf relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Move the tape along the calf to find the maximum circumference, keeping it perpendicular to the leg axis.

fields.definitionEn: Minimum circumference above the medial and lateral ankle bones.
fields.definitionRu: Минимальный обхват над внутренней и наружной лодыжками.
fields.posture: Standing with foot flat and weight balanced.
fields.tapePath: Find the narrowest level immediately above the ankle bones and measure perpendicular to the lower-leg axis.

fields.definitionEn: Barefoot standing vertical height from the floor to the highest point of the head.
fields.definitionRu: Вертикальный рост стоя без обуви от пола до верхней точки головы.
fields.posture: Heels on the floor, weight balanced, body upright without stretching, head in natural forward position.
fields.tapePath: Use a stadiometer or rigid vertical rule and a right-angle headpiece; lower the headpiece to touch the hair with light pressure.
commonMistakes: entering centimetres into the millimetre field

fields.labelRu: от высшей точки плеча до талии спереди
fields.definitionEn: Front surface length from the high point shoulder at the neck-shoulder junction to the marked natural waist plane.
fields.definitionRu: Длина по передней поверхности от высшей точки плеча у основания шеи до отмеченной естественной талии.
landmarks: high point shoulder at neck-shoulder junction
fields.posture: Standing naturally, shoulders relaxed, abdomen relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Follow the front body contour vertically from high point shoulder, over the chest or bust without compression, to the waist cord.

fields.labelRu: от основания шеи до талии по спине
fields.definitionEn: Centre-back surface length from the C7 neck-base prominence to the marked natural waist plane.
fields.definitionRu: Длина по центру спины от выступа C7 у основания шеи до отмеченной естественной талии.
fields.posture: Standing naturally with head forward and shoulders relaxed.
fields.tapePath: Follow the spinal contour from C7 straight down the centre back to the waist cord.

fields.definitionEn: Front torso surface breadth between the left and right anterior axillary folds at the upper-chest level.
fields.definitionRu: Ширина по передней поверхности туловища между передними подмышечными складками на уровне верхней части груди.
fields.posture: Standing naturally, arms relaxed at sides after landmarks are identified.
fields.tapePath: Lay the tape across the front surface between the marked folds without continuing around the sides.

fields.definitionEn: Back torso surface breadth between the left and right posterior axillary folds at the upper-back level.
fields.definitionRu: Ширина по задней поверхности туловища между задними подмышечными складками на уровне верхней части спины.
fields.posture: Standing naturally, arms relaxed and shoulders not rounded forward.
fields.tapePath: Lay the tape across the back surface between the marked folds without continuing around the sides.
commonMistakes: following a full back arc beyond folds

claimBoundary.note: This is a project-owned operational definition intended to make repeated observations comparable. It does not reproduce or claim compliance with any paid ISO, ASTM, or other external standard.

changelog.change: Initial project-owned definitions for all 20 wire fields, with seven analytical-mannequin required fields and an explicit repeated-observation gate.
